purpose: Two fresh-ground same-build cooperative physical missions through v7 state-based insertion, a real five-second finite shutdown tail, actual26payload releases and Ship return. The Booster begins from the actual rigid separation on the same physical clock. H0 is healthy; O0 carries the two fixed representative outages. No saved state initializes either flight. No AI, images, approval workflow or arbitrary faults are claimed.

comparison_reference.scope: Prior N0 suffix supports feasibility context only; no prior record/state/checkpoint is read to initialize or qualify this cohort. HealthyH0 has not been demonstrated by that outage-containing suffix.

invariants: Original profile, mass, propellant, thrust/Isp, aero geometry, actuator limits, integration steps and reserve/contact limits are unchanged.
The oldv5 whole-mission and standalonev7 screen admission/checkers remain strict. A separate explicitv7whole type is required.
Ground origin, actual rigid separation, shutdown availability receipts, complete ascent command/plant chain through cutoff+5s, actual same-state handoff and shared physical clock must be verified.

Only after the measured settled gate may the existing deployment/return loop begin; its schedule is anchored to actual cutoff, not the end of settling. No state/vehicle/clock/fuel/spool reset or saved-state substitution.
Booster receives its actual separation engine availability, Ship keeps its registered RVac outage through release and return; neither is healed.
Each payload release uses physical mass/linear/angular momentum receipts. Report retained inventory and mass, Ship contact and Booster water envelope separately.
Contact is geometric model surface entry, not water response, postcontact support or real Starship landing validation. Old39casecertificate is not reused.

interpretation.valid_success: Freshground samebuild physical composition only. Whole physical success requires independently checked settled insertion, actual26releases, Ship contact envelope and actual-separation Booster water envelope. No AI/allfeatures/qualification/Flight14fidelity claim.
interpretation.valid_negative: Preserve physical ascent failure, surface impact, contact/reserve miss or actual horizon exhaustion as negative. Complete the other registered case without tuning, retries, threshold changes or added candidates.
interpretation.invalid_or_budget: Stop the whole cohort on source/profile/site/goal/environment mismatch, invalid record, numerical exception, serialization/save/restore/hash failure, wall/output/disk breach. Preserve all started artifacts, no retry or resume.
interpretation.all_two_success: Register the next bounded nativeAI and feature regression against this one entry; physical success does not automatically authorize M1/M2/M3, images, symptom diagnosis, arbitraryfaults, certification or develop integration.
interpretation.any_physical_negative: Diagnose preserved records and propose a separate registered Executor/control repair. Do not close whole restoration as complete.

retention: Keep original failed and successful outputs. Archive a manifest of sourcebound plans/claims/logs/rawgzip/results, verify every member and representative actual restore before any separate cleanup; do not change Docker, public branches or merge.
